dialogueEntries.text: You stare at the ceiling... you have no idea what to make of this day...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: Hey honey, are you feeling alright?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: We wanted to check in and see if you were feeling alright.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: Do you need anything from us?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Actually... can you sing me our song?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: You don't know what I mean? It's... nevermind, actually...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Dad
dialogueEntries.text: We're just a call away, okay?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Mom
dialogueEntries.text: Everything will be fine, tomorrow. I promise.
They leave. Today has left you feeling so exhausted....
